mapper.select: SELECT FROM campaign_audience WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND campaign_id = #{campaignId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign_audience (campaign_id, workspace_id, record_type, definition_json, mode) VALUES (#{campaignId}, #{workspaceId}, #{recordType}, #{definitionJson}, #{mode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE record_type = VALUES(record_type), definition_json = VALUES(definition_json), mode = VALUES(mode), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO campaign_audience_snapshot (campaign_id, workspace_id, version, record_type, definition_json, estimated_included, excluded_total, excluded_consent, excluded_suppressed, excluded_restricted, created_by_id) VALUES (#{campaignId}, #{workspaceId}, #{version}, #{recordType}, #{definitionJson}, #{estimatedIncluded}, #{excludedTotal}, #{excludedConsent}, #{excludedSuppressed}, #{excludedRestricted}, #{createdById})
mapper.select: SELECT version, record_type, estimated_included, excluded_total, excluded_consent, excluded_suppressed, excluded_restricted, created_by_id, created_at FROM campaign_audience_snapshot WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND campaign_id = #{campaignId} ORDER BY version DESC
